products.name: Automation Anywhere
products.note: Intelligent automation platform; AI-powered bots; control room governance; credential vault

reading.body:
Automation Anywhere is an enterprise software platform for intelligent automation founded in 2003 and headquartered in California. It combines AI-powered bots, robotic process automation, and agentic orchestration to automate mission-critical workflows.

The company positions itself around coordination of multiple automation types. Its Mozart Orchestrator mechanism is built to manage AI agents, deterministic automations, and human workers together in a single workflow. This modular approach matters because it treats AI agents as one tool among others rather than a replacement for existing enterprise automation logic. The platform includes governance controls and credential vaults, suggesting it addresses security and compliance concerns that arise when automation touches sensitive enterprise systems.

The use cases on Automation Anywhere's site center on IT service management, where the platform targets employee self-service, IT desk workload reduction, and incident prediction. This is a narrower scope than the marketing claim of "number one provider of agentic automation" indicates. The data does not reveal deployment scale, customer count, revenue, or whether the platform's compute demands are significant enough to influence data center or power consumption. The 181 California legal exposure entries reflect its headquarters location but offer no detail on the nature, status, or outcome of any legal matters.

profile_text.body:
Automation Anywhere is a California-based company founded in 2003 that describes itself as a provider of agentic automation. According to its site, its platform combines AI, automation, and robotic process automation (RPA) to deliver what it calls secure end-to-end enterprise agentic automation for mission-critical processes. The company markets a Mozart Orchestrator for building and governing agentic solutions, and it offers a free Cloud Community Edition for instant automation. Its site also presents a partner network and frames its approach as responsible AI and human-centered.

The site's product material centers on an intelligent automation platform with AI-powered bots, control room governance, and a credential vault. The company describes itself as the industry's most advanced and most deployed agentic process automation system, and it cites Gartner's view that more than 90% of so-called agentic AI solutions are repackaged generative AI layered atop legacy systems, with only around 130 vendors among thousands delivering genuine agent-driven orchestration. It also quotes a customer who evaluated Microsoft's Power Automate and chose Automation Anywhere instead.

The held record lists Automation Anywhere under the Automation and Agents category and places its law exposure in California, with a count of 282. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
